title: Solana Mobile Builder Grants
description: Milestone-based grants for teams building mobile-first crypto apps on Android with the Solana Mobile Stack (Mobile Wallet Adapter and Seed Vault). Tooling, content and research that advance the mobile ecosystem are also considered. Apply with any grant idea at any time.
reward: A milestones-based grant, sometimes with co-marketing and launch support; the form offers requests from $10,000 to $50,000
ideas: An Android app using Mobile Wallet Adapter and Seed Vault
Real-time payments using phone location or camera
A mobile app listed on the Solana dApp Store

eligibility.note: a mobile-first Android dApp integrating the Solana Mobile Stack: Mobile Wallet Adapter and Seed Vault

each_time: dApp Store status and funding status
rules: Rolling: you can apply with any grant idea at any time. Review timelines vary and no response time is promised.
Open to any individual, team or organization building mobile-focused dApps for the Solana Mobile ecosystem.

Guidelines: a mobile-first UX on Android using native features; core Solana Mobile Stack integration, including Mobile Wallet Adapter and Seed Vault; a realistic scope with milestones; a team that can execute; a detailed budget; commitment to open source and community benefit.
Proposals are weighed on mobile optimization, Solana Mobile Stack integration, technical depth and impact on the Solana Mobile ecosystem.
Selected teams typically receive a milestones-based grant, sometimes with co-marketing and launch support.
The form asks for a Telegram handle, for contracting purposes.
